args.text: From Moss's North notes, who owns each North account today, and what is the date of the most recent handoff for each? Brackenwater, Orrin Mills, Quarrendon and Tamsin. If no date is written down anywhere for one of them, say so rather than guessing.

@ilse.varga Here's what Moss's North notes say. Owners are as of the latest note, March 2026, so check for changes since then.

Brackenwater Freight Co.: owner Marcus Lindqvist. Most recent handoff 2025-09-15, from Moss's 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest, which says it moves to Marcus "tomorrow, Sept 15".

Orrin Mills: owner Marcus Lindqvist. Most recent handoff 2025-10-06, from Moss's 5 Oct 2025 Sunday prep, which says it moves to Marcus on 6 Oct 2025.

Quarrendon Freight Lines: owner Dana Okafor (the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in calls it Dana's biggest account). No handoff date is written down. The closest dated items are Dana returning on 2026-03-16 and the renewal signed on 2026-03-20 by you (acting) and Thea Ramaswell. Neither is a handoff.

Tamsin Cold Chain: owner Dana Okafor (the Northwest account Dana inherited). No date for that inheritance is written down anywhere I can see.

@ilse.varga One correction to my answer above: no note names an owner for Quarrendon Freight Lines. Dana is the likely owner, since the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in calls it "Dana's biggest account," but that is an inference, so please confirm it with Moss.
